notes.title: Release! Lost Child is available on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Lost Child is now on Steam![/b]
I hope you enjoy my work.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519367/2524e86742867059eb8acfcb079b1559dbf50343.gif"][/img][/h1][h3]Support the project with your review—it’s absolutely essential for me and for the project itself!
Thank you.[/h3][h1][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3540530/Lost_Child/" style="button" buttoncolor="#af0000"]Game page on Steam[/url][/h1]

notes.title: Game release: July 11, 2025 at 10:00 PM GMT+5.
notes.content:
[p][b]Lost Child — release on July 11 at 10:00 PM (GMT+5)[/b][/p][p]On July 11, 2025 at 10:00 PM (GMT+5), the short psychological horror game [b]Lost Child[/b] launches on Steam.[/p][p]What to expect:[/p][list][*][p]~60 minutes of oppressive, tense atmosphere[/p][/*][*][p]Endless, shifting corridors and unexpected jump scares[/p][/*][*][p]Voiceovers in Russian and English[/p][/*][/list][p]Add [b]Lost Child[/b] to your [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3540530/Lost_Child/" style="button"]Wishlist[/url] and support the project—your support is very important![/p][p]See you on July 11!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519367/dc47e9df52f100e700c31967097c489568700f68.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p]
